sections.name: body
sections.value:
PR #256 reviewed at 695aae4a4033941c44dfead656ef070febf9fef9. Runtime TTL enrichment reuses the existing incremental status read; there is no new status/transcript read, launch site, timer or loop. New inputs can increase existing branch frequency: short-TTL large working seats now reach the stale-working activity lookup before the hour, and may reach the existing control-client pane probe/fork fallback if the working activity is itself older than an hour. Review downstream conditions, not only changed lines or launch sites.

Committed on-demand audit smoke, using the existing seven-day report and live read-only store: 12.18s wall, 5.73 CPU-s, maximum RSS175128576B, no swaps. Traverses182 complete Copilot logs3.475GB +93.60MBcalls. Each of three spine queries is SCAN spine_events on2.482GB store. No subprocess inside script; just recipe is nice19. Bound and measure visited bytes; a time-window predicate is not an index seek. Do not schedule this as a periodic sensor without cost review.

Critical audit semantics: cache state != sender guard. At this head stats() uses new_warm to count false cold/silent cold, so it counts small/clear seats as errors. Saved-row guard-only recount: old/new silent970->710, large265->5, warm-large refusals4->56. 165 of reported221 false-cold are small/clear. Added52 warm-large refusals all own300s(32Copilot20OMP), not table. Correctness reviewer pij-obliged-lark corroborated. Future audits must derive guard metrics from new_guard and the old size+idle rule, separately label cache-state metrics, and retain denominator/size/basis breakdowns. A refused send cannot have an observed next-call counterfactual; replay is not a direct false-refusal measurement. Magic wand: a deterministic guard-outcome aggregation boundary in the audit prevents both headline categories from drifting again.

AFTER-DEPLOY DEBT OWNED BY PERFORMANCE: after #256 merge+bounce record actual deployed SHA,time,PID; repeat two timestamped ping/spawns readings, just spawn-rate --seconds20, and daemonCPU/RSS. BEFORE receipt on production408418a18c,PID34653: spawns1763->1763 across20.3384s; machine284.6/s (not PR attributable). Raw receipts /tmp/f214/performance-256-cost-before.json; metadata rows /tmp/f214/performance-256-695aae4.json. After at least3days generate fleet-report from deploy time with --threads2, run audit, check corrected guard-only old/new and actual warm/cold outcomes, warn receipts and send.cold-wake-forced cache_ttl/basis. Publish output note subject f:214-audit-after to pm-001(pij-steady-otter). No post-deploy rate improvement yet proved. Current reviewer seat may close; debt remains with role:performance through verdict --note-owed and this note. Build/test prohibition was honored: CI44457705817 exact-head success used; no local test/build/bounce/install/source edits.
